title: Prognostic value of imaging biomarkers in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma treated with liver Transplantation
summary: The study objective is to evaluate prognostic value of imaging features based on independent reading and radiomics in patients with HCC who underwent liver transplantation. Subsequently the radiomics model shall be complemented with laboratory and clinical data within an integrated diagnostics approach.

interventions.name: It is a retrospective study, the hospital's electronic database will be searched for all patients who received liver transplantation, and for all patients, pre-transplantation CT and MRI images will be collected. HCC lesions will be segmented.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients who underwent liver transplantation in our center with a diagnosis of HCC.
Exclusion criteria:
missing data of the transplantation
no proven diagnosis of HCC
